senses.gloss: a regular pattern or pace in activity or work
senses.example: The staff found a steady rhythm after the new system was introduced.

example_translations.vi_VN: Nhân viên đã tìm được nhịp làm việc ổn định sau khi hệ thống mới được áp dụng.
example_translations.th_TH: พนักงานเริ่มทำงานได้เป็นจังหวะสม่ำเสมอหลังจากมีการนำระบบใหม่มาใช้
